Initial release of Image Generation Generator — Generate Images From Text Prompts.

- Seamless connection setup with support for free anonymous tokens (NEMO_TOKEN).
- 1080p MP4 export available, with rendering times of 20–40 seconds per job.
- Supports uploads, prompt-based generation, and batch processing in the same session.
- Integrated session, credit, and render job management with real-time status feedback.
- Clear error handling, supported format listing, and workflow tips for smooth user experience.
